steps.content: In the middle of the highway, amidst the fiery ruins, Shalom slowly walks over the scorched road surface to find the old man.

His uniform is torn, revealing more than half of his mechanical prosthetic limbs. Even his heart area has a faint light pulsing. At least half of this body has not been destroyed by the impact, it's as resilient as iron.
Several medical personnel rush over, administer CPR, and perform a series of procedures. The old man suddenly opens his eyes and takes a deep breath.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Glad to see you're alright, Commander.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Hush...
He gasps for breath, hard to speak, but his gaze remains fixed on Shalom.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: ...I'm... still alive... Did you use... Rebe...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Rest assured. To use that kind of power on you, I would need to apply for permission, which would certainly not be granted.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Besides, your body is very robust, there's no need for me to intervene.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: ...What about... the others, and...

He turns his head to look in the direction of the transport vehicle. The large vehicle has already toppled over. The contamination cleanup team inspects the remnants of the Mania bomb—no need for further action.
The attack from Schorl directly purified all the contamination, no... it destroyed everything with a power from higher up, a more lethal strike.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The vehicle contained a large amount of level 5 Mania pollutants. You could withstand the impact, but you definitely couldn't withstand the contamination. Direct purification from Paradeisos is the most prudent solution, with the least cost.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: ...With the least cost? Heh...

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Like what you did in the West District in March? BR-002, the second time, was that also what you call the "least cost"?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes. The Underground is in motion, time is limited, and the mission I received was very clear: at <color=#fb9259>all costs</color>.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: ...Understood. If this is the result of Paradeisos's calculations, we can only trust it. Only you can do this.
The Commander-in-Chief murmurs, pushing away the helping hand offered by Hush and struggling to get up. His entire body of metal organs makes a dense noise as he finally stands.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Killing an old man doesn't require such a grand scheme, it's a smokescreen, just like the serial cases they were involved in previously. They're trying to divert our attention to make their next move.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: That woman has an entire <color=#fb9259>assassination list</color>, all the backbone of this operation, the backbone of FAC. She's already got a handle on some of their whereabouts, not all, she's trying to pry my mouth open.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Those scumbags know all too well, killing just me won't be enough, FAC has plenty of warriors. If they want to halt the operation, they'll have to kill everyone.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Dream on!

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Go back, don't waste time on me, round up all the spies and all the agents inside FAC who have turned against us.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Their bold actions mean that our operation plan is already posing a real threat to them, which means we absolutely have to push through.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: An FAC is meant to die on the battlefield against Mania, not at the hands of these scoundrels. We'll continue our fight, you go and make them pay!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Of course, the 9th Agency and HUSH have already taken action. If the enemy can't kill you, their plans will be completely exposed.
A few soldiers rush up to help the old man leave. Before getting into the car, he takes one last look back.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: There's an agent, a Sinner, who locked up the front seats before the explosion, blocking 20% of the firepower. I hope she's okay...

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Is she one of yours?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: She is my subordinate.

steps.speaker: Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: ...Then you truly have no humanity.
The FAC special vehicle drives away. Shalom turns and heads towards the transport vehicle. Rahu is giving first aid to Christina.

The moment the attack was launched, Christina turned to close the door, Rahu left Shalom and rushed to the front of the car, shielding her with her shields. The detective was not directly torn apart by the shockwave from above, but the fused metal still pierced her waist.

She's stuck in place, unable to move, and the loss of blood makes her consciousness hazy. Through the bloody mist in front of her eyes, Christina can't see who's approaching, but she recognizes the familiar footsteps.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Rahu, let me handle this.
She bends down and holds Chris' hand.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Where's the Commander... What about the others...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...I've already dismantled the device... I did it, there was no need...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Not everyone is as sincere as you. That woman has set up even more cruel traps, such a risk cannot be ignored.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Then... Can I go and check? I want to know... whether I managed...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: There's no need for that.
Her right eye reveals a faint triangle, and at the same time, Christina feels something touching her soul.

—It's a touch of white light, a vague giant shadow. Christina feels nauseous, as if she's been invaded and squeezed. The pain in her body is lessening, but the sickness cannot be eliminated. She wants to struggle, wants to shout questions, wants answers.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Tell me...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What the Commander just said, BR-002, the March uprising in the West District... Were you involved?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What do you mean by twice? What about BR-002 in N.F. 104? Is it related to this? Didn't you say... you're still investigating?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Shalom... what you’ve done, is it really... justice?
After a long silence, the nauseous feeling disappeared. Shalom let go of Christina's hand, clean and neat.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Forget it.

Shalom gets up and returns to her Schorl. Christina opens her eyes wide, she finally sees the person in front of her clearly. That person is looking down from a high place, indifferent, looking down at her. Then, she turns her head indifferently.
All of Christina's courage and grievances were instantly shattered by this sudden indifference.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ah... No, wait... I just...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Basic first aid is enough, contact MBCC to take her away. I don't need her anymore.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: No, I just want to know...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I'm sorry, Shalom, I just...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Rahu.
Rahu gets up and leaves Christina once she confirms the arrival of the rescue team.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The West District operation plan has been unanimously approved, the construction of the defense network confirmed: Funds, resources, and manpower will be in place immediately. Internal investigation and tactical meeting will begin immediately.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Underground won't sit idly by, be prepared, X, in this FAC operation, you have a more important, real task to complete.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The requests have been received, and I will fulfill them all, as I always have.
In the distance, the Garden's Mentor who easily escaped is happily looking at the other side of the Rust, where the FAC temporary operation headquarters is emitting a sharp sound.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Oh dear, I failed the task and got made. What should I do next?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Trouble is coming. Dear client, what are you going to do...?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Don't... don't go...
